name: Roc
summary: A gargantuan bird of prey that carries off creatures in its talons.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

actions.name: Talons
actions.onHit: If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=19}) from both talons, and it has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Swoop
bonusActions.text: If the roc has a creature {ref:condition/grappled}, the roc flies up to half its {ref:glossary/fly-speed} without provoking {ref:glossary/opportunity-attacks} and drops that creature.
